name: Tita Luvens
original_name: ティータ・ルーヴェンス
source:
The first princess of the kingdom, she is an optimistic, well-behaved. and intelligent girl.
She is humble and cheerful, which makes her loved by many.
She is knowledgeable, but naive, and treats the most suspicious characters without discrimination.
She is worried about her sister, who hates her for succeeding the throne.
Despite her quiet demeanor, she is strong-willed, and has the drive to take the stand in a difficult situation.
However, her body adapts quickly to pleasure, and she struggles with the pleasures of training and being a noble princess.
